status: owner front photo supports fitted E8 3-4 jumper and D26.22 local copper; replica pin assignment conflicts
observations: Registered D26 lower row begins at component pixel (1550,2270) for pin21, with approximately 60 px pin pitch; pin22 is near (1610,2270).
A white insulated wire runs from a left soldered landing near (1600,2390) to a right soldered landing near (2200,2390), across the E8 marking and aligned with assembly contacts 3 and 4.
The exposed front copper from registered D26 pin22 descends toward the left wire landing; the adjacent E8 contact2 has a separate line from pin23.
Exact .009 assembly depicts the E8 3-4 link below D26; electrical detail puts PB4/pin22 at E8.3 and CONTRDAT at E8.4.

Native front crop (1450,2200)-(2400,2580) shows a short exposed vertical trace from E8.4 right wire landing near (2200,2390) to one joint in the lower X9-region row around (2200,2450); this is a visible same-face copper continuation.
limits: The photo supports the fitted bridge and local exposed copper. The exact .009 table closes A50 to X9:9, but the physical A50 band hole, hidden solder integrity, and continuity to D26.22 still need confirmation. Current board JSON KBD_CONTRDAT assigns D26.23/PB5 and D26_PB4_BOUNDARY isolates D26.22, contrary to the .009 source and observed jumper; retain this as a model correction gate rather than claiming the replica is fixed.
measurement: With power removed, test D26.22 to both E8 jumper ends, E8.4 to full-band solder site6 near (2140,2375), and that site to the actual X9 CONTRDAT conductor. Test D26.23 to E8 contact2 and for isolation from the jumper. Identify the actual A-number before rerouting.

x9_candidate.basis: Reflected D26 local package fit maps the front lower joint near x2200 to solder x≈2150, within about 10 px of full-band site6 x2140; the front trace closes E8.4 to that lower joint. Site numbering is photo band index, not factory A-number.
x9_candidate.limit: The opposite-face same-hole match and cable wire identity have not been independently proved. The table identifies A50 to X9:9, but the 15-site band includes one extra site relative to fourteen A45-A58 wires; site6 cannot yet be assigned A50 from position alone.

factory_connector_path.assembly_connection_table: ДГШ5.109.009 СБ sheet 2, position 153 conductor 6: А:50 -> X9:9
factory_connector_path.conclusion: The drawing destination X9:9 through board point A50 is source-proved; the physical A50 hole in the 15-site owner-photo band is not.
